context7_usage.reason: Pure repo-local wiring: one new module (completion_inbox.py) composing already-existing local read-only helpers (core.list_tasks/core.show_task, mirroring review_summarizer._collect_review_cards) into a new @mcp.tool() on an already-live FastMCP server instance. No external MCP-SDK/API question was open.

summary: Added tools/geoai-task-mcp/src/geoai_task_mcp/completion_inbox.py, a READ-ONLY module combining 4 facets for Codex orchestration: review_queue (canonical-state 'review' cards), stale_processing (canonical-state 'processing' cards whose updated_at/started_at/claimed_at is older than stale_processing_hours, default 24h -- matching AITools/task_activity_facts.py's STALE_WORKER_HOURS precedent), runner_mismatch_warnings (batch-token mismatches between a runner name and the task_id it claimed, a local pure replica of AITools/taskctl.py::_runner_task_batch_mismatch lines 264-295), and latest_validation_facts (validation_status/validation_error/blocker_reason as currently recorded per task). All data is fetched via core.list_tasks()+core.show_task() -- the SAME read-only taskctl.py 'list'/'show' subcommands taskctl.py itself uses internally (cmd_list/cmd_show -> _load_cards() -> taskdb.load_cards() -> bitnnv2/data/tasking/task_queue_v1.sqlite), never a write command and never a new subprocess/exec path. Wired as one new additive @mcp.tool() geoai_completion_inbox(topic, limit, stale_processing_hours) in server.py; every pre-existing tool (B106/B107 readonly set, B110/B111/B116 review-summarizer set, B08 supervisor-loop, B252 launch-queue readonly set) is untouched.

invariant.batch_mismatch_source_of_truth: AITools/taskctl.py:264-295 (_runner_batch_token/_task_batch_token/_runner_task_batch_mismatch), replicated locally per the core.py::_lifecycle_state import-light precedent

public_api.geoai_completion_inbox(topic=None, limit: dict with review_queue, stale_processing, runner_mismatch_warnings, latest_validation_facts, counts, fetch_errors, authority_flags, mutation; writes nothing

read_only_no_agent_launch_property.no_launch_code_marker: server.py and completion_inbox.py contain no process-launch code: no subprocess.Popen, no os-level exec/fork/spawn/system/popen, no shell=True, no pty.spawn -- the only subprocess this module reaches is the pre-existing core.run_taskctl (python3 taskctl.py list/show, both read-only taskctl subcommands, never an agent/model process).
read_only_no_agent_launch_property.queue_db_fingerprint_check: bitnnv2/data/tasking/task_queue_v1.sqlite size+mtime asserted byte-identical before/after a live geoai_completion_inbox MCP call

neural_bridge_note: This wiring adds no new decision authority: all 4 facets are pure views over already-recorded card fields (status/worker_status/timestamps/validation_status) and a deterministic batch-token string comparison -- a support-boundary correctness check per CLAUDE.md's neural-control-first carve-out, not a learned routing decision. No regex/keyword cue router is introduced for task-type or route selection.
